Store tiddler metadata as YAML frontmatter directly inside `.md` files — no `.meta` sidecar needed. Any `.md` file with YAML frontmatter is automatically detected and re-parsed at boot.

## Features

- **Auto-detection** — any `.md` file with `---` delimited YAML frontmatter is recognized automatically
- **Title derivation** — frontmatter `title` field > existing clean title > derived from filepath
- **Syncer-safe** — change events suppressed during re-parse to prevent file corruption
- **Two-pass re-parse** — handles both boot-loaded files and `tiddlywiki.files` entries
- **YAML serialization** — tags and list fields serialized as YAML arrays
- **All markdown types** — `text/markdown`, `text/x-markdown` and `text/x-frontmattered-markdown` are all saved as a single `.md` file
- **Orphan cleanup** — automatic removal of orphaned `.meta` files when migrating
- **Filesystem-watcher compatible** — live external edits work seamlessly
- **Extension hooks** — other plugins can take over the YAML ↔ field mapping and the file path (used by `rimir/okf` for the Open Knowledge Format)

## Extension hooks

| Hook | Called | Arguments | Must return |
|---|---|---|---|
| `th-frontmatter-parse` | after a document's `---` block is split off | `fields`, `{yaml, body, parsed, filepath, pathTitle}` | `fields` |
| `th-frontmatter-serialize` | before a frontmatter file is written | `yamlText`, `tiddler`, `{fileInfo, pathTitle}` | `yamlText` |
| `th-frontmatter-fileinfo` | when the file of a frontmatter tiddler is chosen | `fileInfo`, `tiddler`, `options` | `fileInfo` |

Register them with `$tw.hooks.addHook` in a startup module that runs `before: ["frontmatter"]`, so the boot re-parse already uses them. A hook must always return its first argument (possibly changed) — returning `undefined` breaks the chain.

## Prerequisites

- TiddlyWiki 5.3.0+ (Node.js server edition)
- The official `tiddlywiki/markdown` plugin (for rendering)
- **Restart the server after installing** — the plugin hooks into server-side saving, which only takes effect at boot

## Quick Start

1. Give a tiddler a markdown type — `text/x-frontmattered-markdown`, `text/markdown` or `text/x-markdown`
2. The tiddler is saved as a `.md` file with YAML frontmatter on disk
3. Or place any `.md` file with YAML frontmatter in your tiddlers directory — it is auto-detected at boot

!! Module overview

|!Module |!Type |!Purpose |
|`startup.js` |startup |Auto-detection, re-parse, save pipeline patches |
|`document.js` |library |Parses / builds `--- YAML ---` documents; invokes the parse and serialize hooks |
|`deserializer.js` |tiddlerdeserializer |Registers `text/x-frontmattered-markdown`; delegates to `document.js` |
|`parser.js` |parser |Renders `text/x-frontmattered-markdown` as markdown (strips frontmatter) |
|`yaml.js` |library |YAML parse/serialize (tags and list as arrays) |

!! Boot sequence

# TiddlyWiki boot scans `tiddlers/` — `.md` files without `.meta` get absolute filepath as title
# `startup.js` runs (`after: load-modules`, `before: startup, filesystem-watcher`)
# Registers `text/x-frontmattered-markdown` content type
# ''Pass 1'' — scans `boot.files` for `.md` files with `---` frontmatter pattern
# Suppresses `enqueueTiddlerEvent` (prevents syncer interference)
# Re-deserializes each file, determines title, replaces tiddler in wiki store
# Restores `enqueueTiddlerEvent`
# ''Pass 2'' — scans wiki tiddlers not in `boot.files` (loaded via `tiddlywiki.files`)
# Re-parses frontmatter, keeps existing title
# Syncer starts with correct state — no spurious file operations

!! Title derivation (Pass 1)

Priority order for each re-parsed tiddler:

# ''Frontmatter `title`'' — if YAML frontmatter contains a `title` field, use it
# ''Existing clean title'' — if boot title is not an absolute path (e.g., set by `tiddlywiki.files`), keep it
# ''Filepath-derived'' — for absolute-path titles: compute relative path from tiddlers dir, strip `.md`, replace `path.sep` with `/`

!! Save pipeline patches

The startup module patches three functions:

* `generateTiddlerFileInfo` — forces `.md` extension and `application/x-tiddler-frontmatter` disk type for markdown tiddlers (`text/x-frontmattered-markdown`, `text/markdown`, `text/x-markdown`)
* `saveTiddlerToFile` — serializes as `---\nYAML\n---\ntext` instead of standard TW format; cleans orphaned `.meta` files
* `saveTiddlerToFileSync` — synchronous variant of the above

The `boot.files` entry of a re-parsed file keeps its other properties (`isEditableFile`, `originalpath`), so `retain-original-tiddler-path` and `tiddlywiki.files` paths keep working.

!! Extension points

```
load   .md ──► document.parse ── flat yaml.parse ──► th-frontmatter-parse ──► fields
save   tiddler ──► generateTiddlerFileInfo ──► th-frontmatter-fileinfo ──► fileInfo
               └─► document.build ── yaml.serialize ──► th-frontmatter-serialize ──► ---\nYAML\n---\ntext
```

Without registered hooks the pipeline behaves exactly as before. See Reference → Extension hooks for signatures.

!! I installed the plugin but tiddlers are still saved as `.md` + `.md.meta`

Restart the server. The save hooks are installed by a server-side startup module, which only runs at boot — installing the plugin from the browser makes it visible there, but the running server keeps saving the old way. Check the server log for `frontmatter: Frontmatter plugin initialized`. On Windows, make sure the old `node` process is really gone (a leftover process keeps serving the port).

Also required: the official `tiddlywiki/markdown` plugin.

!! Do I need to set the type on every `.md` file?

No. Any `.md` file with YAML frontmatter (`---` delimiters) is auto-detected at boot. On save, any markdown type (`text/x-frontmattered-markdown`, `text/markdown` or `text/x-markdown`) is written as YAML frontmatter instead of a `.meta` sidecar.

!! Why does the plugin suppress syncer events?

Without suppression, the syncer sees the re-parsed tiddlers as "changed" and tries to delete the original files and re-save them. This corrupts the `.md` files by replacing YAML frontmatter with TiddlyWiki's native format.

!! Why two passes?

Pass 1 handles files discovered by TiddlyWiki's boot scanner (in `boot.files`). Pass 2 handles tiddlers loaded via `tiddlywiki.files` directives — these don't appear in `boot.files` but may still contain YAML frontmatter that needs parsing.

!! Can I use frontmatter with `tiddlywiki.files`?

Yes. Define a `tiddlywiki.files` entry with a clean title. The frontmatter plugin's Pass 2 detects the YAML block and re-parses the fields while keeping the assigned title.

!! Can another plugin change how fields are mapped to YAML?

Yes — via the hooks `th-frontmatter-parse`, `th-frontmatter-serialize` and `th-frontmatter-fileinfo` (see Reference → Extension hooks). `rimir/okf` uses them to read and write Open Knowledge Format files: it parses the raw YAML itself (nested maps, flow lists), maps OKF keys to fields and keeps files at their concept path. Frontmatter itself is unchanged when no hook is registered.

!! What happens to existing `text/x-markdown` tiddlers?

Existing `.md` + `.md.meta` pairs load as before. The next time such a tiddler is saved, it is rewritten as a single frontmatter `.md` (keeping its `text/markdown` / `text/x-markdown` type in the YAML) and the `.meta` sidecar is deleted.

<$fill $name="body">

!! What it does

The frontmatter plugin lets `.md` files carry their tiddler metadata as YAML frontmatter instead of requiring `.meta` sidecar files. This makes markdown files self-contained and compatible with external tools (Claude Code, VS Code, Obsidian, etc.) that understand YAML frontmatter natively.

!! How it works

When a tiddler has a markdown type (`text/x-frontmattered-markdown`, `text/markdown` or `text/x-markdown`), it is saved to disk as a single `.md` file (no `.meta` sidecar):

```
---
tags:
  - documentation
  - example
created: "20260330120000000"
modified: "20260330120000000"
title: Example
---

# Markdown content here
```

At boot, the startup module auto-detects ''any'' `.md` file with a `---` YAML frontmatter block and re-parses it — no explicit type annotation needed. This means external tools can create `.md` files with frontmatter and TiddlyWiki will pick them up automatically.

!! Key design decisions

* ''All markdown types'' — core would save `text/markdown` / `text/x-markdown` as `.md` + `.md.meta`; the plugin writes them as frontmatter `.md` too, persisting `type` so it round-trips
* ''Auto-detect over opt-in'' — any `.md` with frontmatter is re-parsed, not just files with `text/x-frontmattered-markdown`
* ''Syncer suppression'' — change events are suppressed during re-parse to prevent the syncer from deleting originals and re-saving in TW format
* ''Two-pass architecture'' — first pass handles `boot.files` (filesystem-scanned), second pass handles `tiddlywiki.files`-loaded tiddlers
* ''Title priority'' — frontmatter `title` > existing clean title (from `tiddlywiki.files`) > derived from filepath
* ''Extensible, not configurable'' — the YAML mapping is fixed and flat; plugins with other needs (e.g. `rimir/okf`) take over through three hooks instead of options here
* ''Runs before syncer'' — startup module runs `before: ["startup"]` so the syncer's initial snapshot sees already-fixed state

</$fill>
</$transclude>

!! Content type

|!Type |!Purpose |
|`text/x-frontmattered-markdown` |Default tiddler type for frontmatter `.md` files — assigned on load when the YAML has no `type` |
|`text/markdown`, `text/x-markdown` |Also saved as frontmatter `.md` (instead of core's `.md` + `.md.meta`); `type` is persisted in the YAML |
|`application/x-tiddler-frontmatter` |Internal disk type — used by save pipeline patches |

!! YAML field handling

|!Field |!YAML format |
|`tags` |Array: `tags:\n  - tag1\n  - tag2` |
|`list` |Array: `list:\n  - item1\n  - item2` |
|`title` |Persisted — the filename can't represent every title character (TW maps `:` etc. to `_`) |
|`type` |Omitted when `text/x-frontmattered-markdown` (implied); persisted for other markdown types |
|`bag` |Excluded (sync-internal) |
|`text` |Excluded from frontmatter (appears after `---` closing delimiter) |
|All other fields |Scalar: `field-name: value`. Values with YAML-reserved characters are double-quoted; `\` and `"` inside are backslash-escaped and unescaped again on load |

!! Frontmatter format

```
---
tags:
  - tag1
  - tag2
custom-field: value
title: "Title: with colon"
---

Markdown body text here
```

!! Extension hooks

Other plugins can take over how frontmatter maps YAML to fields and where files go. `rimir/okf` (Open Knowledge Format) is built on these hooks.

|!Hook |!Called |!Arguments |!Must return |
|`th-frontmatter-parse` |After a document's `---` block is split off and flat-parsed (boot re-parse, deserializer, `deserializeTiddlers`) |`fields` — result of the flat parse incl. `text`; `info` — `{yaml, body, parsed, filepath, pathTitle}` |`fields` (may be a new object) |
|`th-frontmatter-serialize` |Before a frontmatter `.md` file is written (async and sync saver) |`yamlText` — frontmatter's own YAML; `tiddler`; `info` — `{fileInfo, pathTitle}` |`yamlText` (without the `---` lines) |
|`th-frontmatter-fileinfo` |When `generateTiddlerFileInfo` handles a tiddler saved as frontmatter |`fileInfo` — `.md`, no `.meta`; `tiddler`; `options` — as passed to `generateTiddlerFileInfo` (`directory`, `fileInfo` of the existing file, `wiki`, …) |`fileInfo` |

|!Info key |!Meaning |
|`yaml` |Raw YAML text between the `---` lines — parse it yourself when the flat parse isn't enough (nested maps, flow lists) |
|`body` |Text after the closing `---` |
|`parsed` |Flat parse result — the keys frontmatter added to `fields` |
|`filepath` |File being loaded; only set during the boot re-parse |
|`pathTitle` |Title the file's path yields (path relative to `tiddlers/`, minus `.md`, `/` as separator), i.e. the title a file gets when its YAML names none; `undefined` when unknown |

Rules:

* Register the hooks with `$tw.hooks.addHook` in a startup module with `before: ["frontmatter"]` — the boot re-parse runs inside frontmatter's startup
* Always return the first argument (changed or not). `invokeHook` passes each return value on; `undefined` breaks the chain
* The hooks only fire for markdown tiddlers and frontmatter documents; text without a `---` block never reaches `th-frontmatter-parse`
* After the parse hook, a missing `type` is still set to `text/x-frontmattered-markdown`

!! Restart rules

|!Change |!Restart? |
|`startup.js` |Yes |
|`deserializer.js` |Yes |
|`parser.js` |Yes |
|`yaml.js` |Yes |
|`document.js` |Yes |
|New `.md` files added to tiddlers/ |No (filesystem-watcher picks them up) |

</$fill>

title: $:/plugins/rimir/frontmatter/document.js
type: application/javascript
module-type: library

Parses and builds frontmatter documents (--- YAML --- body).
Both directions invoke a hook so other plugins (e.g. rimir/okf) can take over
the mapping between YAML and tiddler fields:

* th-frontmatter-parse(fields, info) -> fields
* th-frontmatter-serialize(yamlText, tiddler, info) -> yamlText

startup.js additionally invokes th-frontmatter-fileinfo(fileInfo, tiddler, options)
-> fileInfo when choosing the file of a tiddler saved as frontmatter.

\*/

"use strict";

var yaml = require("$:/plugins/rimir/frontmatter/yaml.js");

var FRONTMATTER_RE = /^---\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---\r?\n?([\s\S]*)$/;
var TW_DATE_RE = /^\-?\d{17,}$/;
var DATE_FIELDS = {"created": true, "modified": true};

exports.DEFAULT_TYPE = yaml.DEFAULT_TYPE;

exports.hasFrontmatter = function(text) {
	return FRONTMATTER_RE.test(text || "");
};

/**
 * Normalize a date string to TW format (YYYYMMDDHHMMSSmmm).
 * Accepts TW format (passthrough), ISO 8601, or JS Date.toString() format.
 */
var normalizeDate = exports.normalizeDate = function(value) {
	if(!value) {
		return value;
	}
	// Already in TW format
	if(TW_DATE_RE.test(value)) {
		return value;
	}
	// Try parsing as a JS date string
	var d = new Date(value);
	if(!isNaN(d.getTime())) {
		return $tw.utils.stringifyDate(d);
	}
	return value;
};

/**
 * Parse a frontmatter document into `fields` (which may carry preset fields).
 * info: {filepath, pathTitle} — both optional, passed on to the parse hook.
 * Returns the resulting fields object.
 */
exports.parse = function(text, fields, info) {
	info = info || {};
	var match = FRONTMATTER_RE.exec(text);
	if(match) {
		var parsed = yaml.parse(match[1]);
		for(var key in parsed) {
			// Normalize date fields to TW format
			if(DATE_FIELDS[key]) {
				parsed[key] = normalizeDate(parsed[key]);
			}
			fields[key] = parsed[key];
		}
		fields.text = match[2];
		fields = $tw.hooks.invokeHook("th-frontmatter-parse", fields, {
			yaml: match[1],
			body: match[2],
			parsed: parsed,
			filepath: info.filepath,
			pathTitle: info.pathTitle
		});
	} else {
		fields.text = text;
	}
	if(!fields.type) {
		fields.type = yaml.DEFAULT_TYPE;
	}
	return fields;
};

/**
 * Build the file content for a tiddler.
 * info: {fileInfo, pathTitle} — passed on to the serialize hook.
 */
exports.build = function(tiddler, info) {
	var yamlText = yaml.serialize(tiddler.fields);
	yamlText = $tw.hooks.invokeHook("th-frontmatter-serialize", yamlText, tiddler, info || {});
	return "---\n" + yamlText + "\n---\n" + (tiddler.fields.text || "");
};

Store tiddler metadata as YAML frontmatter directly inside `.md` files — no `.meta` sidecar needed. Any `.md` file with YAML frontmatter is automatically detected and re-parsed at boot.

!! Features

* ''Auto-detection'' — any `.md` file with `---` delimited YAML frontmatter is recognized automatically
* ''Title derivation'' — frontmatter `title` field > existing clean title > derived from filepath
* ''Syncer-safe'' — change events suppressed during re-parse to prevent file corruption
* ''Two-pass re-parse'' — handles both boot-loaded files and `tiddlywiki.files` entries
* ''YAML serialization'' — tags and list fields serialized as YAML arrays
* ''All markdown types'' — `text/markdown`, `text/x-markdown` and `text/x-frontmattered-markdown` are all saved as a single `.md` file
* ''Orphan cleanup'' — automatic removal of orphaned `.meta` files when migrating
* ''Filesystem-watcher compatible'' — live external edits work seamlessly
* ''Extension hooks'' — other plugins can take over the YAML ↔ field mapping and the file path (used by `rimir/okf` for the Open Knowledge Format); see Documentation → Reference

!! Prerequisites

title: $:/plugins/rimir/frontmatter/startup.js
type: application/javascript
module-type: startup

Registers content type, patches save pipeline for frontmatter markdown files,
and re-parses any .md files with frontmatter that were loaded at boot before
the deserializer was available.

\*/

"use strict";

exports.name = "frontmatter";
exports.after = ["load-modules"];
exports.before = ["startup","filesystem-watcher"];
exports.synchronous = true;

var FILE_ON_DISK_TYPE = "application/x-tiddler-frontmatter";
var CONTENT_TYPE = require("$:/plugins/rimir/frontmatter/yaml.js").DEFAULT_TYPE;
// Tiddler types saved as frontmatter .md (core would otherwise write .md + .md.meta)
var SAVED_AS_FRONTMATTER = {"text/x-markdown": true, "text/markdown": true};
SAVED_AS_FRONTMATTER[CONTENT_TYPE] = true;

exports.startup = function() {
	// --- A. Register content type and parser mapping (runs on all platforms) ---

	$tw.config.contentTypeInfo[CONTENT_TYPE] = {
		encoding: "utf8",
		extension: ".md",
		flags: [],
		deserializerType: CONTENT_TYPE
	};

	// Everything below is Node.js only (file I/O)
	if(!$tw.node) {
		return;
	}

	var path = require("path");
	var fs = require("fs");
	var doc = require("$:/plugins/rimir/frontmatter/document.js");

	var logger = new $tw.utils.Logger("frontmatter", {colour: "cyan"});
	var tiddlersPath = path.resolve($tw.boot.wikiTiddlersPath || path.join($tw.boot.wikiPath, "tiddlers"));

	// Title a file inside the tiddlers dir gets when its frontmatter names none
	function titleFromPath(filepath) {
		var rel = path.relative(tiddlersPath, filepath);
		if(!rel || rel.indexOf("..") === 0 || path.isAbsolute(rel)) {
			return undefined;
		}
		return rel.replace(/\.md$/, "").split(path.sep).join("/");
	}

	function buildContent(tiddler, fileInfo) {
		return doc.build(tiddler, {fileInfo: fileInfo, pathTitle: titleFromPath(fileInfo.filepath)});
	}

	// --- B. Re-parse boot-loaded .md files with frontmatter ---

	if($tw.boot.files) {
		var titlesToReparse = [];
		$tw.utils.each($tw.boot.files, function(fileInfo, title) {
			if(fileInfo.hasMetaFile) {
				return;
			}
			if(path.extname(fileInfo.filepath) !== ".md") {
				return;
			}
			// Read the file and check for YAML frontmatter pattern
			try {
				var content = fs.readFileSync(fileInfo.filepath, "utf8");
				if(doc.hasFrontmatter(content)) {
					titlesToReparse.push({
						oldTitle: title,
						fileInfo: fileInfo,
						filepath: fileInfo.filepath,
						content: content
					});
				}
			} catch(e) {
				// File may have been deleted — skip
			}
		});
		var reparsedCount = 0;
		// Suppress change events during re-parse so the syncer doesn't
		// delete original files and re-save them with TW serialization
		var origEnqueue = $tw.wiki.enqueueTiddlerEvent;
		$tw.wiki.enqueueTiddlerEvent = function() {};
		for(var i = 0; i < titlesToReparse.length; i++) {
			var item = titlesToReparse[i];
			// Title if the frontmatter doesn't name one: an absolute boot title is
			// derived from the path; a clean one (e.g., from tiddlywiki.files) is kept
			var pathTitle = path.isAbsolute(item.oldTitle) ? titleFromPath(item.filepath) : item.oldTitle;
			var newFields = doc.parse(item.content, {}, {filepath: item.filepath, pathTitle: pathTitle});
			var newTitle = newFields.title || pathTitle || item.oldTitle;
			newFields.title = newTitle;
			// Remove old tiddler, add new one (change events suppressed)
			if(item.oldTitle !== newTitle) {
				$tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(item.oldTitle);
				delete $tw.boot.files[item.oldTitle];
			}
			$tw.wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(newFields));
			// Keep the rest of the entry (isEditableFile/originalpath from
			// retain-original-tiddler-path or tiddlywiki.files)
			$tw.boot.files[newTitle] = $tw.utils.extend({}, item.fileInfo, {
				filepath: item.filepath,
				type: CONTENT_TYPE,
				hasMetaFile: false
			});
			reparsedCount++;
		}
		// Restore change events
		$tw.wiki.enqueueTiddlerEvent = origEnqueue;
		if(reparsedCount > 0) {
			logger.log("Re-parsed " + reparsedCount + " frontmatter .md files");
		}
		// --- B2. Re-parse markdown tiddlers loaded via tiddlywiki.files (not in boot.files) ---
		var wikiToReparse = [];
		$tw.wiki.each(function(tiddler, title) {
			if($tw.boot.files[title]) {
				return; // Already handled above
			}
			var text = tiddler.fields.text || "";
			if(doc.hasFrontmatter(text)) {
				wikiToReparse.push({title: title, text: text});
			}
		});
		for(var w = 0; w < wikiToReparse.length; w++) {
			var wItem = wikiToReparse[w];
			var wFields = doc.parse(wItem.text, {}, {pathTitle: wItem.title});
			wFields.title = wItem.title;
			$tw.wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(wFields));
		}
		if(wikiToReparse.length > 0) {
			logger.log("Re-parsed " + wikiToReparse.length + " in-wiki frontmatter tiddlers");
		}
	}

	// --- C. Patch generateTiddlerFileInfo ---

	var origGenerateTiddlerFileInfo = $tw.utils.generateTiddlerFileInfo;
	$tw.utils.generateTiddlerFileInfo = function(tiddler, options) {
		var fileInfo = origGenerateTiddlerFileInfo.apply(this, arguments);
		if(SAVED_AS_FRONTMATTER[tiddler.fields.type]) {
			fileInfo.type = FILE_ON_DISK_TYPE;
			fileInfo.hasMetaFile = false;
			// Ensure .md extension
			if(path.extname(fileInfo.filepath) !== ".md") {
				fileInfo.filepath = fileInfo.filepath.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ".md");
			}
			fileInfo = $tw.hooks.invokeHook("th-frontmatter-fileinfo", fileInfo, tiddler, options);
		}
		return fileInfo;
	};

	// --- D. Patch saveTiddlerToFile ---

	var origSaveTiddlerToFile = $tw.utils.saveTiddlerToFile;
	$tw.utils.saveTiddlerToFile = function(tiddler, fileInfo, callback) {
		if(fileInfo.type === FILE_ON_DISK_TYPE) {
			var content = buildContent(tiddler, fileInfo);
			$tw.utils.createDirectory(path.dirname(fileInfo.filepath));
			fs.writeFile(fileInfo.filepath, content, "utf8", function(err) {
				if(err) {
					return callback(err);
				}
				// Clean up orphaned .meta file if it exists
				var metaPath = fileInfo.filepath + ".meta";
				if(fs.existsSync(metaPath)) {
					fs.unlink(metaPath, function(unlinkErr) {
						if(unlinkErr) {
							logger.log("Warning: could not delete orphaned .meta file: " + metaPath);
						} else {
							logger.log("Deleted orphaned .meta file: " + metaPath);
						}
						callback(null, fileInfo);
					});
				} else {
					callback(null, fileInfo);
				}
			});
			return;
		}
		return origSaveTiddlerToFile.apply(this, arguments);
	};

	// --- E. Patch saveTiddlerToFileSync ---

	var origSaveTiddlerToFileSync = $tw.utils.saveTiddlerToFileSync;
	$tw.utils.saveTiddlerToFileSync = function(tiddler, fileInfo) {
		if(fileInfo.type === FILE_ON_DISK_TYPE) {
			var content = buildContent(tiddler, fileInfo);
			$tw.utils.createDirectory(path.dirname(fileInfo.filepath));
			fs.writeFileSync(fileInfo.filepath, content, "utf8");
			// Clean up orphaned .meta file if it exists
			var metaPath = fileInfo.filepath + ".meta";
			if(fs.existsSync(metaPath)) {
				try {
					fs.unlinkSync(metaPath);
					logger.log("Deleted orphaned .meta file: " + metaPath);
				} catch(e) {
					logger.log("Warning: could not delete orphaned .meta file: " + metaPath);
				}
			}
			return fileInfo;
		}
		return origSaveTiddlerToFileSync.apply(this, arguments);
	};

	logger.log("Frontmatter plugin initialized");
};

Tests for the frontmatter deserializer module.

\*/
"use strict";

var helpers = require("$:/plugins/rimir/frontmatter/test/helpers.js");

describe("frontmatter deserializer", function() {

	helpers.isolateHooks(beforeEach, afterEach);

	var deserialize;

	beforeEach(function() {
		deserialize = $tw.Wiki.tiddlerDeserializerModules["text/x-frontmattered-markdown"];
	});

	it("should be registered as a deserializer", function() {
		expect(deserialize).toBeDefined();
		expect(typeof deserialize).toBe("function");
	});

	it("should parse frontmatter fields into tiddler fields", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: My Tiddler\nauthor: rimir\n---\nBody text here.";
		var fields = {};
		var result = deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(result.length).toBe(1);
		expect(fields.title).toBe("My Tiddler");
		expect(fields.author).toBe("rimir");
		expect(fields.text).toBe("Body text here.");
	});

	it("should set type to text/x-frontmattered-markdown by default", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: Test\n---\nBody";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.type).toBe("text/x-frontmattered-markdown");
	});

	it("should not override existing type field from frontmatter", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: Test\ntype: text/x-markdown\n---\nBody";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.type).toBe("text/x-markdown");
	});

	it("should handle text without frontmatter", function() {
		var text = "Just plain markdown without frontmatter.";
		var fields = {};
		var result = deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(result.length).toBe(1);
		expect(fields.text).toBe("Just plain markdown without frontmatter.");
		expect(fields.title).toBeUndefined();
	});

	it("should handle empty body after frontmatter", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: Empty Body\n---\n";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.title).toBe("Empty Body");
		expect(fields.text).toBe("");
	});

	it("should handle multiline body after frontmatter", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: Multi\n---\nLine 1\nLine 2\nLine 3";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.text).toBe("Line 1\nLine 2\nLine 3");
	});

	it("should handle Windows line endings in frontmatter", function() {
		var text = "---\r\ntitle: Windows\r\nauthor: test\r\n---\r\nBody here.";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.title).toBe("Windows");
		expect(fields.author).toBe("test");
	});

	it("should parse tags from frontmatter YAML arrays", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: Tagged\ntags:\n  - TagA\n  - Tag With Space\n---\nBody";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.tags).toBe("TagA [[Tag With Space]]");
	});

	it("should normalize ISO date strings to TW format", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: Dated\ncreated: 2025-03-15T14:30:00Z\n---\nBody";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		// Should be converted to TW date format
		expect(fields.created).toMatch(/^\d{17}$/);
	});

	it("should pass through TW-format dates unchanged", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: Dated\ncreated: 20250315143000000\n---\nBody";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.created).toBe("20250315143000000");
	});

	it("should normalize modified field dates", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: Dated\nmodified: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z\n---\nBody";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.modified).toMatch(/^\d{17}$/);
	});

	it("should not normalize non-date fields", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: Test\nauthor: 2025-01-01\n---\nBody";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.author).toBe("2025-01-01");
	});

	it("should handle frontmatter with no trailing newline after closing ---", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: NoTrail\n---\nBody text";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.title).toBe("NoTrail");
		expect(fields.text).toBe("Body text");
	});

	it("should handle frontmatter with only --- delimiters", function() {
		var text = "---\n\n---\nBody";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.text).toBe("Body");
	});

	it("should handle body containing --- lines (not at start)", function() {
		var text = "---\ntitle: Test\n---\nSome text\n---\nMore text";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.title).toBe("Test");
		expect(fields.text).toBe("Some text\n---\nMore text");
	});

	it("should preserve an unparseable date string instead of dropping the field", function() {
		// `created: "soon"` is not TW-format and `new Date("soon")` is Invalid.
		// The contract: pass it through unchanged rather than emit "Invalid Date"
		// or silently drop the field — the user can fix it later.
		var text = "---\ntitle: Quirky\ncreated: soon\n---\nBody";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		expect(fields.created).toBe("soon");
	});

	it("should not fabricate a date when frontmatter has an empty date field", function() {
		// `created:` (no value after colon) — round-trip safety: the resulting
		// field must either be empty or absent, never `Invalid Date` or `NaN`.
		var text = "---\ntitle: Empty\ncreated:\n---\nBody";
		var fields = {};
		deserialize(text, fields);
		// Whatever the exact shape (undefined or ""), it must not be a parsed-but-invalid date.
		expect(fields.created === undefined || fields.created === "").toBe(true);
	});
});

var helpers = require("$:/plugins/rimir/frontmatter/test/helpers.js");

var doc = require("$:/plugins/rimir/frontmatter/document.js");

describe("frontmatter hooks", function() {

	helpers.isolateHooks(beforeEach, afterEach);

		});

			seen = {fields: $tw.utils.extend({}, fields), info: info};
			return fields;
		});
		doc.parse("---\na: 1\nnested:\n  x: y\n---\nBody", {}, {filepath: "/w/tiddlers/x.md", pathTitle: "x"});
		expect(seen.fields.a).toBe("1");
		expect(seen.fields.text).toBe("Body");
		expect(seen.info.yaml).toBe("a: 1\nnested:\n  x: y");
		expect(seen.info.body).toBe("Body");
		expect(seen.info.parsed.a).toBe("1");
		expect(seen.info.filepath).toBe("/w/tiddlers/x.md");
		expect(seen.info.pathTitle).toBe("x");
	});

	it("should use the fields returned by th-frontmatter-parse", function() {
		addHook("th-frontmatter-parse", function(fields, info) {
			return {title: "Replaced", text: info.body, type: "text/markdown"};
		});
		var fields = $tw.wiki.deserializeTiddlers("text/x-frontmattered-markdown", "---\na: 1\n---\nBody", {})[0];
		expect(fields.title).toBe("Replaced");
		expect(fields.a).toBeUndefined();
		expect(fields.type).toBe("text/markdown");
	});

	it("should not invoke th-frontmatter-parse for text without frontmatter", function() {
		var called = false;
		addHook("th-frontmatter-parse", function(fields) {
			called = true;
			return fields;
		});
		var fields = doc.parse("plain", {});
		expect(called).toBe(false);
		expect(fields.text).toBe("plain");
		expect(fields.type).toBe(doc.DEFAULT_TYPE);
	});

	it("should let th-frontmatter-serialize replace the YAML", function() {
		var seen;
		addHook("th-frontmatter-serialize", function(yamlText, tiddler, info) {
			seen = {yamlText: yamlText, title: tiddler.fields.title, info: info};
			return "custom: yes";
		});
		var tiddler = new $tw.Tiddler({title: "T", caption: "C", text: "Body"});
		var content = doc.build(tiddler, {pathTitle: "T"});
		expect(content).toBe("---\ncustom: yes\n---\nBody");
		expect(seen.yamlText).toContain("caption: C");
		expect(seen.title).toBe("T");
		expect(seen.info.pathTitle).toBe("T");
	});
	if($tw.node) {
		it("should let th-frontmatter-fileinfo change the file of a frontmatter tiddler", function() {
			addHook("th-frontmatter-fileinfo", function(fileInfo, tiddler, options) {
				fileInfo.filepath = options.directory + "/custom.md";
				return fileInfo;
			});
			var md = $tw.utils.generateTiddlerFileInfo(new $tw.Tiddler({title: "A", type: "text/markdown"}), {directory: "/w", wiki: $tw.wiki});
			var tid = $tw.utils.generateTiddlerFileInfo(new $tw.Tiddler({title: "B", type: "text/vnd.tiddlywiki"}), {directory: "/w", wiki: $tw.wiki});
			expect(md.filepath).toBe("/w/custom.md");
			expect(tid.filepath).not.toBe("/w/custom.md");
		});
	}
});

\*/
"use strict";

var helpers = require("$:/plugins/rimir/frontmatter/test/helpers.js");

if($tw.node) {

var fs = require("fs");
var os = require("os");
var path = require("path");

describe("frontmatter save pipeline", function() {

	helpers.isolateHooks(beforeEach, afterEach);

	var dir;

	beforeEach(function() {
		dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "fm-save-"));
	});

	afterEach(function() {
		fs.rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true});
	});

	// existingInfo mimics the boot.files entry the filesystem adaptor passes for a known tiddler
	function save(fields, existingInfo) {
		var tiddler = new $tw.Tiddler(fields);
		var fileInfo = $tw.utils.generateTiddlerFileInfo(tiddler, {directory: dir, wiki: $tw.wiki, fileInfo: existingInfo});
		$tw.utils.saveTiddlerToFileSync(tiddler, fileInfo);
		return fileInfo;
	}

	["text/x-frontmattered-markdown", "text/markdown", "text/x-markdown"].forEach(function(type) {

		it("should save " + type + " as a single .md file with frontmatter", function() {
			var fileInfo = save({title: "Doc", type: type, caption: "Cap", text: "# Body"});
			expect(fileInfo.hasMetaFile).toBe(false);
			expect(path.extname(fileInfo.filepath)).toBe(".md");
			expect(fs.existsSync(fileInfo.filepath + ".meta")).toBe(false);
			var content = fs.readFileSync(fileInfo.filepath, "utf8");
			expect(content).toMatch(/^---\n/);
			expect(content).toContain("caption: Cap");
			expect(content).toContain("title: Doc");
			expect(content).toMatch(/\n---\n# Body$/);
		});

		it("should round-trip " + type + " through the deserializer", function() {
			var fileInfo = save({title: "Doc", type: type, caption: "Cap", text: "# Body"});
			var content = fs.readFileSync(fileInfo.filepath, "utf8");
			var fields = $tw.wiki.deserializeTiddlers("text/x-frontmattered-markdown", content, {})[0];
			expect(fields.title).toBe("Doc");
			expect(fields.type).toBe(type);
			expect(fields.caption).toBe("Cap");
			expect(fields.text).toBe("# Body");
		});
	});

	it("should keep fields of a tiddler with empty text", function() {
		var fileInfo = save({title: "Empty", type: "text/markdown", caption: "Only a caption"});
		var content = fs.readFileSync(fileInfo.filepath, "utf8");
		expect(content).toContain("caption: Only a caption");
		expect(fs.existsSync(fileInfo.filepath + ".meta")).toBe(false);
	});

	it("should remove a pre-existing .md.meta sidecar", function() {
		var mdPath = path.join(dir, "Old.md");
		fs.writeFileSync(mdPath, "# old");
		fs.writeFileSync(mdPath + ".meta", "title: Old\ntype: text/markdown\n");
		var fileInfo = save({title: "Old", type: "text/markdown", text: "# new"},
			{filepath: mdPath, type: "text/markdown", hasMetaFile: true});
		expect(fileInfo.filepath).toBe(mdPath);
		expect(fs.existsSync(mdPath + ".meta")).toBe(false);

"use strict";

var yaml = require("$:/plugins/rimir/frontmatter/yaml.js");

describe("frontmatter yaml.parse", function() {

	it("should parse simple key-value pairs", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("title: My Tiddler\nauthor: rimir");
		expect(result.title).toBe("My Tiddler");
		expect(result.author).toBe("rimir");
	});

	it("should parse quoted values with double quotes", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse('description: "A tiddler with: colons"');
		expect(result.description).toBe("A tiddler with: colons");
	});

	it("should parse quoted values with single quotes", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("description: 'A tiddler with: colons'");
		expect(result.description).toBe("A tiddler with: colons");
	});

	it("should parse array values", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("tags:\n  - TagA\n  - TagB\n  - TagC");
		expect(result.tags).toBe("TagA TagB [[TagC]]".replace("[[TagC]]", "TagC"));
		// tags field gets joined as TW list
		expect(result.tags).toContain("TagA");
		expect(result.tags).toContain("TagB");
	});

	it("should wrap array items with spaces in double brackets for tags", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("tags:\n  - Simple\n  - Has Space");
		expect(result.tags).toBe("Simple [[Has Space]]");
	});

	it("should wrap array items with spaces in double brackets for list", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("list:\n  - one\n  - two words");
		expect(result.list).toBe("one [[two words]]");
	});

	it("should join array values with spaces for non-tags/list fields", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("custom:\n  - a\n  - b\n  - c");
		expect(result.custom).toBe("a b c");
	});

	it("should skip empty lines", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("title: Test\n\nauthor: rimir");
		expect(result.title).toBe("Test");
		expect(result.author).toBe("rimir");
	});

	it("should skip comment lines", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("# This is a comment\ntitle: Test");
		expect(result.title).toBe("Test");
		expect(Object.keys(result).length).toBe(1);
	});

	it("should skip lines without colons", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("title: Test\nno-colon-here\nauthor: rimir");
		expect(result.title).toBe("Test");
		expect(result.author).toBe("rimir");
	});

	it("should handle empty value (key with no value after colon)", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("title: Test\nempty:\nnext: value");
		expect(result.title).toBe("Test");
		expect(result.next).toBe("value");
		// empty key without array items following is not set
	});

	it("should handle Windows line endings", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("title: Test\r\nauthor: rimir");
		expect(result.title).toBe("Test");
		expect(result.author).toBe("rimir");
	});

	it("should return empty object for empty input", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("");
		expect(Object.keys(result).length).toBe(0);
	});

	it("should handle values containing colons", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("url: http://example.com:8080/path");
		expect(result.url).toBe("http://example.com:8080/path");
	});

	it("should handle array followed by key-value", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("tags:\n  - A\n  - B\nauthor: rimir");
		expect(result.tags).toBe("A B");
		expect(result.author).toBe("rimir");
	});

	it("should unquote array items", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse('tags:\n  - "Quoted Tag"\n  - plain');
		expect(result.tags).toBe("[[Quoted Tag]] plain");
	});

	it("should handle trailing array at end of input", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("tags:\n  - X\n  - Y");
		expect(result.tags).toBe("X Y");
	});
});

describe("frontmatter yaml.serialize", function() {

	it("should serialize simple fields", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({author: "rimir", caption: "Test"});
		expect(result).toContain("author: rimir");
		expect(result).toContain("caption: Test");
	});

	it("should exclude text, type, and bag fields but persist title", function() {
		// `title` MUST round-trip through YAML: the filename can't represent
		// every title character (TW translates `:` etc. on save), so we lose
		// information if the title isn't written into the file body.
		var result = yaml.serialize({
			title: "MyTitle", text: "body", type: "text/x-frontmattered-markdown",
			bag: "default", author: "rimir"
		});
		expect(result).toContain("title: MyTitle");
		expect(result).not.toContain("text:");
		expect(result).not.toContain("type:");
		expect(result).not.toContain("bag:");
		expect(result).toContain("author: rimir");
	});

	it("should persist type when it is not the default frontmatter type", function() {
		expect(yaml.serialize({title: "T", type: "text/markdown"})).toContain("type: text/markdown");
		expect(yaml.serialize({title: "T", type: "text/x-markdown"})).toContain("type: text/x-markdown");
	});

	it("should quote titles that contain colons or other YAML-reserved characters", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({
			title: "work/mgm/partnerships/ps:open_text/x.msg.email",
			author: "rimir"
		});
		// title must come through with the colons intact (quoted).
		expect(result).toMatch(/title: ["']work\/mgm\/partnerships\/ps:open_text\/x\.msg\.email["']/);
	});

	it("should sort keys alphabetically", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({zoo: "z", alpha: "a", mid: "m"});
		var lines = result.split("\n");
		expect(lines[0]).toBe("alpha: a");
		expect(lines[1]).toBe("mid: m");
		expect(lines[2]).toBe("zoo: z");
	});

	it("should serialize array fields as YAML arrays", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({tags: ["TagA", "TagB"]});
		expect(result).toContain("tags:");
		expect(result).toContain("  - TagA");
		expect(result).toContain("  - TagB");
	});

	it("should skip empty arrays", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({tags: []});
		expect(result).toBe("");
	});

	it("should serialize string tags as YAML arrays", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({tags: "TagA TagB"});
		expect(result).toContain("tags:");
		expect(result).toContain("  - TagA");
		expect(result).toContain("  - TagB");
	});

	it("should serialize string list field as YAML arrays", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({list: "one two three"});
		expect(result).toContain("list:");
		expect(result).toContain("  - one");
		expect(result).toContain("  - two");
		expect(result).toContain("  - three");
	});

	it("should quote values with special characters", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({desc: "has: colon"});
		expect(result).toContain('desc: "has: colon"');
	});

	it("should quote empty string values", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({empty: ""});
		expect(result).toContain('empty: ""');
	});

	it("should convert non-string values to strings", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({num: 42});
		expect(result).toContain("num: 42");
	});

	it("should serialize TW date strings as-is", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({created: "20250101120000000"});
		expect(result).toContain("created: 20250101120000000");
	});

	it("should quote values starting with special YAML characters", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({note: "- list item"});
		expect(result).toContain('note: "- list item"');
	});

	it("should quote values starting with whitespace", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({val: " leading space"});
		expect(result).toContain('val: " leading space"');
	});

	it("should serialize tags with spaces as unquoted YAML array items", function() {
		var result = yaml.serialize({tags: "Simple [[Has Space]]"});
		expect(result).toContain("  - Has Space");
		expect(result).toContain("  - Simple");
	});
});

describe("frontmatter yaml round-trip", function() {

	it("should round-trip simple fields", function() {
		var original = {author: "rimir", caption: "My Caption"};
		var serialized = yaml.serialize(original);
		var parsed = yaml.parse(serialized);
		expect(parsed.author).toBe("rimir");
		expect(parsed.caption).toBe("My Caption");
	});

	it("should round-trip tags with spaces", function() {
		var serialized = yaml.serialize({tags: "Simple [[Tag With Spaces]]"});
		var parsed = yaml.parse(serialized);
		expect(parsed.tags).toBe("Simple [[Tag With Spaces]]");
	});

	it("should round-trip values with colons", function() {
		var serialized = yaml.serialize({url: "http://example.com:8080"});
		var parsed = yaml.parse(serialized);
		expect(parsed.url).toBe("http://example.com:8080");
	});

	it("should round-trip TW date strings", function() {
		var serialized = yaml.serialize({modified: "20250315143000000"});
		var parsed = yaml.parse(serialized);
		expect(parsed.modified).toBe("20250315143000000");
	});

	it("should round-trip values containing double quotes and backslashes", function() {
		var original = {title: 'Say "hi" \\ there', path: "C:\\dir\\file", mixed: '\\"'};
		var parsed = yaml.parse(yaml.serialize(original));
		expect(parsed.title).toBe(original.title);
		expect(parsed.path).toBe(original.path);
		expect(parsed.mixed).toBe(original.mixed);
	});

	it("should be stable across repeated save/load cycles", function() {
		var title = 'Quote " and backslash \\';
		var fields = {title: title};
		for(var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
			fields = yaml.parse(yaml.serialize(fields));
		}
		expect(fields.title).toBe(title);
	});

	it("should round-trip non-default markdown types", function() {
		var parsed = yaml.parse(yaml.serialize({title: "T", type: "text/markdown"}));
		expect(parsed.type).toBe("text/markdown");
	});
});

describe("frontmatter yaml.parse escapes", function() {

	it("should unescape \\\" and \\\\ inside double-quoted values", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse('a: "x\\"y\\\\z"');
		expect(result.a).toBe('x"y\\z');
	});

	it("should keep backslashes literal in single-quoted values", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("a: 'x\\y'");
		expect(result.a).toBe("x\\y");
	});

	it("should keep backslashes literal in unquoted values", function() {
		var result = yaml.parse("a: x\\y");
		expect(result.a).toBe("x\\y");
	});
});

Minimal YAML parser/serializer for flat tiddler field maps.
Handles string values and arrays (for tags). No nested objects.

\*/

"use strict";

/**
 * Tiddler type assigned to frontmatter .md files when none is stored in the YAML.
 */
var DEFAULT_TYPE = exports.DEFAULT_TYPE = "text/x-frontmattered-markdown";

/**
 * Characters that require quoting in YAML values.
 */
var NEEDS_QUOTING = /[:#\[\]{}&*!|>'"%@`\r\n]|^[\s-]|[\s]$/;

/**
 * Parse a YAML frontmatter string into a fields object.
 * Supports simple key: value pairs and array values (- item lines).
 */
exports.parse = function(yamlText) {
	var fields = Object.create(null);
	var lines = yamlText.split(/\r?\n/);
	var currentKey = null;
	var arrayValues = null;
	for(var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
		var line = lines[i];
		// Skip empty lines and comments
		if(line.trim() === "" || line.charAt(0) === "#") {
			continue;
		}
		// Check for array item (indented with "- ")
		var arrayMatch = /^[ \t]+- (.*)$/.exec(line);
		if(arrayMatch && currentKey) {
			if(!arrayValues) {
				arrayValues = [];
			}
			arrayValues.push(unquote(arrayMatch[1].trim()));
			continue;
		}
		// Flush previous array if any
		if(currentKey && arrayValues) {
			fields[currentKey] = arrayToTiddlyWikiList(currentKey, arrayValues);
			arrayValues = null;
		}
		// Parse key: value
		var colonPos = line.indexOf(":");
		if(colonPos === -1) {
			continue;
		}
		currentKey = line.substring(0, colonPos).trim();
		var rawValue = line.substring(colonPos + 1).trim();
		if(rawValue === "") {
			// Value might be on following lines (array or multi-line)
			arrayValues = null;
			// Don't set fields yet — wait to see if array items follow
			continue;
		}
		fields[currentKey] = unquote(rawValue);
		currentKey = null;
		arrayValues = null;
	}
	// Flush final array
	if(currentKey && arrayValues) {
		fields[currentKey] = arrayToTiddlyWikiList(currentKey, arrayValues);
	}
	return fields;
};

/**
 * Serialize a tiddler fields object to YAML frontmatter string.
 * Excludes "text", "bag" and a default "type".
 */
exports.serialize = function(fields) {
	var lines = [];
	var keys = Object.keys(fields).sort();
	// `title` MUST be persisted into the YAML — the filename is a lossy
	// reflection of the tiddler title (TW translates `:` → `_` and other
	// filesystem-invalid characters), so deriving the title back from the
	// filepath at load time corrupts tiddlers whose title contains such
	// characters. `text` is the body; `type` is only persisted when it isn't
	// DEFAULT_TYPE (which the deserializer assigns), so text/markdown and
	// text/x-markdown keep their type. `bag` is TW-internal sync state and
	// irrelevant on disk.
	for(var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
		var key = keys[i];
		if(key === "text" || key === "bag" || (key === "type" && fields.type === DEFAULT_TYPE)) {
			continue;
		}
		var value = fields[key];
		// Handle array fields (tags, list) — serialize as YAML arrays
		if(Array.isArray(value)) {
			if(value.length > 0) {
				lines.push(key + ":");
				for(var a = 0; a < value.length; a++) {
					lines.push("  - " + quote(String(value[a])));
				}
			}
			continue;
		}
		if(value instanceof Date) {
			value = $tw.utils.stringifyDate(value);
		} else if(typeof value !== "string") {
			value = String(value);
		}
		// String-form tags/list: parse and serialize as YAML array
		if((key === "tags" || key === "list") && value) {
			var items = $tw.utils.parseStringArray(value);
			if(items && items.length > 0) {
				lines.push(key + ":");
				for(var s = 0; s < items.length; s++) {
					lines.push("  - " + quote(items[s]));
				}
				continue;
			}
		}
		lines.push(key + ": " + quote(value));
	}
	return lines.join("\n");
};

/**
 * Remove surrounding quotes from a YAML value.
 * Double-quoted values have the escapes written by quote() reversed.
 */
function unquote(value) {
	if(value.length >= 2) {
		if(value.charAt(0) === '"' && value.charAt(value.length - 1) === '"') {
			return value.substring(1, value.length - 1).replace(/\\(["\\])/g, "$1");
		}
		if(value.charAt(0) === "'" && value.charAt(value.length - 1) === "'") {
			return value.substring(1, value.length - 1);
		}
	}
	return value;
}

/**
 * Quote a YAML value if it contains special characters.
 */
function quote(value) {
	if(value === "") {
		return '""';
	}
	if(NEEDS_QUOTING.test(value)) {
		return '"' + value.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/"/g, '\\"') + '"';
	}
	return value;
}

/**
 * Convert an array of values to a TiddlyWiki string list.
 * For "tags" and "list" fields, uses TW's [[double bracket]] syntax for items with spaces.
 */
function arrayToTiddlyWikiList(fieldName, values) {
	if(fieldName === "tags" || fieldName === "list") {
		var parts = [];
		for(var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
			var v = values[i];
			if(v.indexOf(" ") !== -1) {
				parts.push("[[" + v + "]]");
			} else {
				parts.push(v);
			}
		}
		return parts.join(" ");
	}
	// For other array fields, just join with spaces
	return values.join(" ");
}
